name: NC-MSEN Pre-College Program (NC State)
org: NC State, NC Mathematics and Science Education Network
what_you_do: STEM classes for students in grades 6 to 12. There are fall and summer programs to get ready for a STEM major in college.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 6 through 12. NC State chapter works with schools in northeastern and central North Carolina.
deadline_text: Late September for fall programs, late April or early May for summer programs (from the 2026 listing).
how_to_apply: Apply through the MSEN office. See the program website (fi.ncsu.edu/teams/msen).
notes: Dates are last year's pattern. Contact the MSEN office about scholarships.
